steps.en: Ask your agent to install just the skill you want
steps.zh: 让 agent 只装你需要的那一个 skill

steps.en: The agent clones that skill directory into place — no paths for you to manage
steps.zh: agent 把该 skill 目录装到技能位置，不用你管路径

steps.en: Later, trigger it with one plain sentence
steps.zh: 之后随时用一句自然中文触发它
steps.code: 帮我看看存储 · 今天 AI 圈有什么新东西 · /neat

steps.en: The skill's structured instructions run and deliver: cleanup report, AI digest, doc-memory reconciliation
steps.zh: 按技能内的指令交付：清理报告、AI 日报或文档记忆对齐

value.en: Six daily-chores skills the author actually runs, instead of writing and maintaining your own SKILL.md
value.zh: 不必自己写 SKILL.md，直接用作者每天真在用的现成技能

sources: README.md main @ b81ad3b (retrieved 2026-09-28): 安装方式 `帮我安装这个 skill：https://github.com/KKKKhazix/khazix-skills/tree/main/<skill-name>`、`Agent 会自己 clone 到对应目录`; 怎么触发 `帮我看看存储`、`今天 AI 圈有什么新东西`、`/neat`; Skills 目录表（leader、storage-analyzer、aihot、neat-freak、hv-analysis、khazix-writer 各一句话）
